pageCache.text:
Free Breakfast & After School Clubs
At Mundella we offer a free Breakfast Club for children to give them a good start to the day. Children also get the opportunity to socialise and play games before the start of their learning.
We also offer free After School Activity Clubs each term, these run from 3:15-4:15pm. Places are offered on a first come first served basis and are the perfect opportunity for children to develop new skills and make friends.
Finally, we offer an After School Child Care Club that costs £6 per child per day. This runs from 3:15-5pm and includes fun activities and a snack.
